summary: Iteration 16 — Frontend-only verification of tappable visit cards on the Map tab. All requested checks PASS. Cards are now Pressable and open the same detail sheet as a pin tap. See-customer-history nav still works. Chevron indicator is rendered (via Ionicons font glyph). No critical console errors related to setSelectedVisit. CHECK 3 (End button) SKIPPED because no active (unended) visits exist in the seeded dataset — every visit already has ended_at.

checks.check_1_card_opens_sheet: PASS — 13 cards found; tapping first card ('TEST_AutoW_B') showed visit-detail-close and matching sheet title (verified via screenshot iteration_16_visitsheet.png). see-customer-history was also visible.
checks.check_2_see_customer_history_nav: PASS — customer-history-back visible after tap; customer name present on /customer/[name] screen.
checks.check_3_end_button_no_sheet: SKIPPED — no active visits (all seeded visits already have ended_at). Not a failure.
checks.check_4_chevron_visible: PASS — DOM shows a trailing element with font-family='Ionicons' (chevron-forward glyph) on every visit card; visually confirmed in screenshot as '>' on right edge of each card. Note: on web Ionicons renders as font glyphs (unicode), not SVG, so string-match on 'chevron-forward' inside HTML is false but the icon IS rendered.
checks.check_5_console_errors: PASS — only 2 benign 'shadow* style props are deprecated' warnings and one unrelated 401 network resource. No setSelectedVisit / 'Cannot read' / 'undefined is not a function' errors.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — appears twice on Map screen. Not part of this iteration but worth migrating in a follow-up.

unexpected_console_output: warning: "shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow". (x2)
error: Failed to load resource: 401 (unrelated network resource, not blocking)
action_items: None blocking. Optional: migrate shadow* → boxShadow in map.tsx styles to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
Optional: to fully test the End-button-doesn't-open-sheet regression, seed at least one visit without ended_at so an End button is rendered.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4 PASS, 1 SKIPPED due to seed data)

context_for_next_testing_agent: map.tsx list cards are Pressable → open selectedVisit detail modal. End button uses e.stopPropagation. Chevron rendered via Ionicons font (font-family='Ionicons'), not SVG, so DOM string searches for 'chevron-forward' will not match on web — confirm visually or by checking font-family attribute.
